spec.description:
APM dashboard for monitoring OpenTelemetry-based services.  

Instrument your applications using OpenTelemetry SDKs and send traces, metrics, and logs to Jaeger for traces, a Prometheus-compatible database for metrics, and OpenSearch for logs. This dashboard provides a centralized view of your application's health and performance.

HTTP & RPC endpoints aggregation on the `http.server.request.duration` & `rpc.server.duration` metrics.

See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/http/http-metrics/#metric-httpserverrequestduration and https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/rpc/rpc-metrics/#metric-rpcserverduration
spec.title: Duration

spec.expr:
(
    (sum by(service_namespace, service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name=~"$service_name", http.response.status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval])) * 100) 
    / 
    sum by(service_namespace, service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]))
)
or
(
    0
    * 
    sum by(service_namespace, service_name) (rate(http_server_request_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]))
)

((sum without (rpc_grpc_status_code, instance) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name=~"$service_name", rpc_grpc_status_code!="0"}[$__rate_interval])) * 100) / sum without (rpc_grpc_status_code, instance) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))
or
(0 * sum without (rpc_grpc_status_code, instance) (rate(rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.description:
HTTP and RPC endpoints aggregation on the `http.server.request.duration` and `rpc.server.duration` metrics. 

Errors are identified by : 
* `http.response.status_code=~"5.."`
* `rpc.grpc.status_code!="0"`

See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/http/http-metrics/#metric-httpserverrequestduration
spec.title: Error

spec.title: Request Rate

spec.description:
HTTP calls made by the service based on the `http.client.request.duration` metric.

Calls broken done by remote `server.address` and by `http.request.method`.

See https://opentelemetry.io/docs/specs/semconv/http/http-metrics/#metric-httpclientrequestduration
spec.title: Outbound HTTP Services

spec.expr:
(
        sum by (database) (
            label_join(
                rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name=~"$service_name", http.response.status_code=~"5.."}[$__rate_interval]),
                "database",
                "/",
                "server_address",
                "db_namespace"
            )
        )
     / 
        sum by (database) (
            label_join(
                rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "database",
                "/",
                "server_address",
                "db_namespace"
            )
        )
    ) or (0 * 
        sum by (database) (
            label_join(
                rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name=~"$service_name"}[$__rate_interval]),
                "database",
                "/",
                "server_address",
                "db_namespace"
            )
        )
    )

histogram_quantile(
    0.99,
    sum by (le, database) (
        label_join(
        rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service_namespace=~"$service_namespace", service_name=~"$service_name"}[5m]),
            "database",
            "/",
            "server_address",
            "db_namespace"
        )
    )
)
